## Carousel

- Changing game now works like the Apple TV app: the logo, stats and buttons fade out, the next game's picture dissolves in over the old one (which darkens as it's covered, with a slight sideways drift), and then its logo and buttons fade back in. The same change is used when a trailer ends, when you swipe, tap the dots or use the controller.
- Swiping moves the picture just a little under your finger; past the first or last game it wraps round.
